d: Pale honey-blonde hair is styled with thick, swept bangs and shoulder-length waves. Large, bright azure eyes have a wide, innocent expression on a youthful, child-like face. The build is petite, dressed in a high-collared black garment under a vibrant red cloak with a blue gemstone centerpiece. Signature details include a golden crown with sharp peaks and a long, dark teardrop-shaped earring.
